verdict.rationale: YYLO's integrations feature can pull Slack messages or GitHub issues into a kanban/ledger task (yylo-docs-10) and its ledger CLI creates structured tasks with status/tags (yylo-docs-11), which loosely maps to turning feedback into structured tasks. However, there is no evidence of any 'proposed scope' generation, effort estimation, or PM-oriented scoping workflow—tasks are just status/tag records, not spec proposals. Missing for 10: explicit feedback-to-task conversion workflow for PMs, scope/estimate generation, and any UI/output showing a 'proposed scope' artifact.
